name: FileTransferResponse
description: Accepted/rejected tokens exchanged over the REGULAR_FILE_RESPONSE channels. Each token encodes the responder's identity so a cross-channel read is detectable rather than silently wrong. Both PC and Android must write and compare these exact strings — define them here once and generate both sides.

members.name: ACCEPTED_FROM_PC
members.description: PC accepted Android's incoming file — Android may open REGULAR_FILE_DATA_ANDROID_TO_PC and stream bytes.

members.name: REJECTED_FROM_PC
members.description: PC rejected Android's incoming file — Android must abort without opening REGULAR_FILE_DATA_ANDROID_TO_PC.

members.name: ACCEPTED_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android accepted PC's incoming file — PC may open REGULAR_FILE_DATA_PC_TO_ANDROID and stream bytes.

members.name: REJECTED_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android rejected PC's incoming file — PC must abort without opening REGULAR_FILE_DATA_PC_TO_ANDROID.
